semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: The source permits arbitrary legal subgradient choices. This module uses one fixed noncomputable current-loss/current-point selector. Its global absolute-loss support equality includes every slope in [-1,1] at a tie. The exact coefficient-one bound with eta_T=1/sqrt(T) is derived from the shared OSD tuning result. Each positive known horizon chooses a separate constant-step run, shared by all fixed comparators. The eventual average conclusion is one-sided; it is not signed or absolute convergence to zero. General finite-history policy results remain with open PR149/181/182. The finite guarantee retains the source played-label feasibility binder even though the proof does not use it. The eventual guarantee assumes a globally feasible label sequence and fixes the comparator. A separate attained best-hindsight minimum interface, an anytime guarantee, randomized-law/measurability semantics, executable numerical oracle, whole chapter/book acceptance, purification and Exposition Seal are not established.
